value.rationale: Determines the complete natural first-failure acceptance invariant for exact MMS under monotone goods, strengthening the previously known existence construction to necessity and sufficiency. Proves every failing instance must have unique MMS partitions and no additional acceptable bundle; establishes 30 labeled patterns in one symmetry class and sharp 4/5 threshold. These facts clarify the extremal small-n base of Feige 2026 Question 22 rather than being an arbitrary numerical slice.
